caption: Five practical AI prompts for everyday tasks. Give the AI useful context, check the answer, and adapt it to your needs. Save these for later. #AI #AITips #Productivity

slides.title: Give AI a better brief
slides.body: Five practical prompts for everyday tasks. Replace vague requests with clear instructions you can actually use.

slides.title: Turn a messy list into a plan
slides.body: Prompt: Organise these tasks by deadline and importance. Suggest a realistic order and flag anything that needs more information. Tasks: [paste your list].

slides.title: Understand something unfamiliar
slides.body: Prompt: Explain [topic] in plain English. Give one everyday example, then ask me three questions to check my understanding. Flag anything uncertain.

slides.title: Make your writing clearer
slides.body: Prompt: Edit this draft for clarity while keeping my tone. Do not add facts. Show the revised version and explain your three most useful changes. Draft: [paste].

slides.title: Compare your options
slides.body: Prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] against these criteria: [list]. Use only the information below. Mark missing details instead of guessing. Information: [paste].

slides.title: Practise a conversation
slides.body: Prompt: Role-play [situation] with me. Ask one question at a time. After five exchanges, give specific feedback on how clearly I communicated.

slides.title: Try one. Check the result.
slides.body: Choose a prompt, add your context and refine the answer. Check important facts and leave private information out. Save this carousel for your next AI session.
